entities.name: PMID:27515066
observations: Experimental study tested erythrocyte effects on platelet and purified soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC), monitoring platelet VASP Ser239 phosphorylation.

entities.name: Erythrocytes fail to activate sGC
observations: RBCs did not activate platelet or purified sGC in tested settings, including whole blood, hypoxia, NO-loaded RBCs, and conditions optimal for RBC-mediated NO generation from nitrite; RBCs instead scavenged NO and inhibited NO-mediated signaling.
